views.comment: Catalog-derived terminal writer detector. Mutation verbs must target an exact terminal-truth relation; unrelated type references cannot create false authority.
views.definition:
SELECT p.oid,
    p.oid::regprocedure::text AS routine_identity,
    p.proname,
    p.prorettype <> 'trigger'::regtype::oid AND (has_function_privilege('anon'::name, p.oid, 'EXECUTE'::text) OR has_function_privilege('authenticated'::name, p.oid, 'EXECUTE'::text) OR has_function_privilege('service_role'::name, p.oid, 'EXECUTE'::text)) AS application_callable,
    lower(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)) AS definition,
    lower(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)) ~ '(insert[[:space:]]+into|update|delete[[:space:]]+from|truncate([[:space:]]+table)?)[[:space:]]+public[.]?(sessions|completion_responses|scan_events|maintenance_tickets)([^a-z0-9_]|$)'::text AS mutates_terminal_truth,
    p.proname ~~ 'demo_scan_mock_%'::text OR p.proname = 'custodial_finish_historical_session_authoritative'::name OR lower(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)) ~ 'public[.]demo_scan_mock_[a-z0-9_]*[[:space:]]*[(]'::text OR lower(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)) ~ 'public[.](purge_closed_scan_history_before|tool_purge_closed_scan_history_before|close_maintenance_ticket|tool_close_maintenance_ticket|force_close_session|tool_force_close_session|start_session|tool_start_session|finish_session|tool_finish_session|complete_session|tool_complete_session|record_scan_event|tool_record_scan_event)[[:space:]]*[(]'::text AS delegates_alternate_terminal_authority
   FROM pg_proc p
     JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace
  WHERE n.nspname = 'public'::name AND p.prokind = 'f'::"char";

WITH cfg AS (
         SELECT get_setting_int('stale_session_timeout_minutes'::text, 120) AS stale_timeout_minutes,
            get_setting_int('scan_history_warning_mb'::text, 350) AS scan_history_warning_mb,
            operational_day_start(now()) AS operational_day_start
        ), storage AS (
         SELECT scan_history_storage_summary() AS summary
        ), counts AS (
         SELECT ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM custodial_open_work() custodial_open_work(open_work_id, source_kind, session_id, context_id, session_uuid, client_session_id, location_id, location_code, location_name, employee_id, employee_name, device_id, device_identifier, status, started_at, ended_at, duration_minutes, duration_display, created_at)
                  WHERE custodial_open_work.status = 'active'::text) AS active_sessions,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM custodial_open_work() custodial_open_work(open_work_id, source_kind, session_id, context_id, session_uuid, client_session_id, location_id, location_code, location_name, employee_id, employee_name, device_id, device_identifier, status, started_at, ended_at, duration_minutes, duration_display, created_at)
                  WHERE custodial_open_work.status = 'pending_submit'::text) AS pending_submit_sessions,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM sessions
                  WHERE sessions.status = 'closed'::text AND COALESCE(sessions.ended_at, sessions.started_at, sessions.created_at) >= (( SELECT cfg.operational_day_start
                           FROM cfg))) AS closed_sessions_today,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM v_open_maintenance_tickets) AS open_ticket_count,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM v_location_dashboard_status
                  WHERE v_location_dashboard_status.status_code = 'overdue'::text) AS overdue_locations,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM v_location_dashboard_status
                  WHERE v_location_dashboard_status.status_code = 'due_soon'::text) AS due_soon_locations,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM v_location_dashboard_status
                  WHERE v_location_dashboard_status.status_code = 'in_progress'::text) AS in_progress_locations,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM locations
                  WHERE locations.active = true) AS active_locations,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM devices
                  WHERE devices.active = true) AS active_devices,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM devices
                  WHERE devices.active = true AND devices.last_seen_at >= (now() - '24:00:00'::interval)) AS devices_seen_last_24h,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM devices
                  WHERE devices.active = true AND (devices.last_seen_at IS NULL OR devices.last_seen_at < (now() - '24:00:00'::interval))) AS devices_missing_recent_heartbeat,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM custodial_open_work() custodial_open_work(open_work_id, source_kind, session_id, context_id, session_uuid, client_session_id, location_id, location_code, location_name, employee_id, employee_name, device_id, device_identifier, status, started_at, ended_at, duration_minutes, duration_display, created_at)
                  WHERE COALESCE(custodial_open_work.ended_at, custodial_open_work.started_at) <= (now() - make_interval(mins => ( SELECT cfg.stale_timeout_minutes
                           FROM cfg)))) AS stale_open_sessions,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM system_logs
                  WHERE (system_logs.level = ANY (ARRAY['WARN'::text, 'ERROR'::text])) AND system_logs.created_at >= (now() - '24:00:00'::interval)) AS warn_error_logs_last_24h
        )
 SELECT now() AS snapshot_at,
    ( SELECT cfg.operational_day_start
           FROM cfg) AS operational_day_start,
    ( SELECT cfg.stale_timeout_minutes
           FROM cfg) AS stale_timeout_minutes,
    ( SELECT cfg.scan_history_warning_mb
           FROM cfg) AS scan_history_warning_mb,
    counts.active_sessions,
    counts.pending_submit_sessions,
    counts.closed_sessions_today,
    counts.open_ticket_count,
    counts.overdue_locations,
    counts.due_soon_locations,
    counts.in_progress_locations,
    counts.active_locations,
    counts.active_devices,
    counts.devices_seen_last_24h,
    counts.devices_missing_recent_heartbeat,
    counts.stale_open_sessions,
    counts.warn_error_logs_last_24h,
    storage.summary AS storage_summary
   FROM counts
     CROSS JOIN storage;

SELECT d.id AS device_pk,
    d.device_id,
    d.device_name,
    d.active,
    e.display_name AS assigned_employee_name,
    d.notes,
    d.last_seen_at,
    d.created_at,
    d.updated_at
   FROM devices d
     LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.id = d.assigned_employee_id;

views.comment: Rolling 30-day production quality-inspection coverage with an explicit operational target and attention state.
views.definition:
WITH finished AS (
         SELECT s.id,
            COALESCE(s.ended_at, s.started_at) AS finished_at
           FROM sessions s
          WHERE (s.status = ANY (ARRAY['pending_submit'::text, 'closed'::text])) AND COALESCE(s.ended_at, s.started_at) >= (now() - '30 days'::interval)
        ), coverage AS (
         SELECT count(*)::integer AS completed_session_count,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM cleaning_inspections i
                  WHERE i.session_id = f.id)))::integer AS inspected_session_count,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM cleaning_inspections i
                  WHERE i.session_id = f.id)))::integer AS uninspected_session_count,
            max(f.finished_at) AS latest_completed_session_at
           FROM finished f
        ), policy AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(( SELECT (system_settings.setting_value #>> '{}'::text[])::numeric AS "numeric"
                   FROM system_settings
                  WHERE system_settings.setting_key = 'inspection_coverage_target_pct'::text), 20::numeric) AS target_pct
        )
 SELECT c.completed_session_count,
    c.inspected_session_count,
    c.uninspected_session_count,
        CASE
            WHEN c.completed_session_count = 0 THEN 0::numeric
            ELSE round(c.inspected_session_count::numeric * 100.0 / c.completed_session_count::numeric, 1)
        END AS inspection_coverage_pct,
    p.target_pct AS inspection_coverage_target_pct,
    c.completed_session_count > 0 AND (c.inspected_session_count::numeric * 100.0 / c.completed_session_count::numeric) < p.target_pct AS needs_attention,
    c.latest_completed_session_at,
    ( SELECT max(i.inspected_at) AS max
           FROM cleaning_inspections i) AS latest_inspection_at,
    30 AS window_days
   FROM coverage c
     CROSS JOIN policy p;

views.comment: Employee-by-location cleaning duration, issue, and inspection comparison with location baselines.
views.definition:
WITH facts AS (
         SELECT v_cleaning_session_facts.session_id,
            v_cleaning_session_facts.session_uuid,
            v_cleaning_session_facts.client_session_id,
            v_cleaning_session_facts.status,
            v_cleaning_session_facts.location_id,
            v_cleaning_session_facts.location_code,
            v_cleaning_session_facts.location_name,
            v_cleaning_session_facts.location_type,
            v_cleaning_session_facts.employee_id,
            v_cleaning_session_facts.employee_code,
            v_cleaning_session_facts.employee_name,
            v_cleaning_session_facts.device_id,
            v_cleaning_session_facts.device_identifier,
            v_cleaning_session_facts.started_at,
            v_cleaning_session_facts.ended_at,
            v_cleaning_session_facts.duration_minutes,
            v_cleaning_session_facts.duration_display,
            v_cleaning_session_facts.completion_source,
            v_cleaning_session_facts.completion_response_id,
            v_cleaning_session_facts.completion_submitted_at,
            v_cleaning_session_facts.services_performed,
            v_cleaning_session_facts.cleaning_note,
            v_cleaning_session_facts.maintenance_ticket_count,
            v_cleaning_session_facts.open_maintenance_ticket_count,
            v_cleaning_session_facts.maintenance_issue_categories,
            v_cleaning_session_facts.maintenance_fixture_identifiers,
            v_cleaning_session_facts.inspection_count,
            v_cleaning_session_facts.inspection_score_total,
            v_cleaning_session_facts.average_inspection_score,
            v_cleaning_session_facts.inspection_pass_count,
            v_cleaning_session_facts.latest_inspection_score,
            v_cleaning_session_facts.latest_inspection_passed,
            v_cleaning_session_facts.latest_inspected_at,
            v_cleaning_session_facts.latest_inspection_notes
           FROM v_cleaning_session_facts
          WHERE v_cleaning_session_facts.status = 'closed'::text AND v_cleaning_session_facts.duration_minutes IS NOT NULL AND v_cleaning_session_facts.duration_minutes >= 0
        ), employee_location AS (
         SELECT facts.employee_id,
            facts.employee_code,
            facts.employee_name,
            facts.location_id,
            facts.location_code,
            facts.location_name,
            count(*)::integer AS cleaning_count,
            round(avg(facts.duration_minutes), 1) AS average_duration_minutes,
            round(percentile_cont(0.5::double precision) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (facts.duration_minutes::double precision))::numeric, 1) AS median_duration_minutes,
            round(percentile_cont(0.9::double precision) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (facts.duration_minutes::double precision))::numeric, 1) AS p90_duration_minutes,
            min(facts.duration_minutes) AS minimum_duration_minutes,
            max(facts.duration_minutes) AS maximum_duration_minutes,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE facts.started_at >= (now() - '30 days'::interval))::integer AS cleanings_last_30_days,
            round(avg(facts.duration_minutes) FILTER (WHERE facts.started_at >= (now() - '30 days'::interval)), 1) AS average_duration_last_30_days,
            sum(facts.maintenance_ticket_count)::integer AS maintenance_ticket_count,
            round(sum(facts.maintenance_ticket_count)::numeric / NULLIF(count(*), 0)::numeric, 2) AS maintenance_tickets_per_cleaning,
            sum(facts.inspection_count)::integer AS inspection_count,
            round(sum(facts.inspection_score_total) / NULLIF(sum(facts.inspection_count), 0)::numeric, 1) AS average_inspection_score,
            round(100.0 * sum(facts.inspection_pass_count)::numeric / NULLIF(sum(facts.inspection_count), 0)::numeric, 1) AS inspection_pass_rate_pct,
            max(facts.started_at) AS latest_cleaning_at
           FROM facts
          GROUP BY facts.employee_id, facts.employee_code, facts.employee_name, facts.location_id, facts.location_code, facts.location_name
        ), location_baseline AS (
         SELECT facts.location_id,
            round(avg(facts.duration_minutes), 1) AS location_average_duration_minutes,
            round(sum(facts.inspection_score_total) / NULLIF(sum(facts.inspection_count), 0)::numeric, 1) AS location_average_inspection_score
           FROM facts
          GROUP BY facts.location_id
        )
 SELECT el.employee_id,
    el.employee_code,
    el.employee_name,
    el.location_id,
    el.location_code,
    el.location_name,
    el.cleaning_count,
    el.average_duration_minutes,
    el.median_duration_minutes,
    el.p90_duration_minutes,
    el.minimum_duration_minutes,
    el.maximum_duration_minutes,
    el.cleanings_last_30_days,
    el.average_duration_last_30_days,
    el.maintenance_ticket_count,
    el.maintenance_tickets_per_cleaning,
    el.inspection_count,
    el.average_inspection_score,
    el.inspection_pass_rate_pct,
    el.latest_cleaning_at,
    lb.location_average_duration_minutes,
    round(el.average_duration_minutes - lb.location_average_duration_minutes, 1) AS duration_delta_from_location_minutes,
    lb.location_average_inspection_score,
    round(el.average_inspection_score - lb.location_average_inspection_score, 1) AS inspection_score_delta_from_location
   FROM employee_location el
     JOIN location_baseline lb ON lb.location_id = el.location_id;

views.comment: One durable fact row per cleaning session, including services, maintenance issues, and inspection outcomes.
views.definition:
SELECT s.id AS session_id,
    s.session_uuid,
    s.client_session_id,
    s.status,
    s.location_id,
    l.location_code,
    l.location_name,
    l.location_type,
    s.employee_id,
    e.employee_code,
    e.display_name AS employee_name,
    s.device_id,
    d.device_id AS device_identifier,
    s.started_at,
    s.ended_at,
    s.duration_minutes,
    s.duration_display,
    s.completion_source,
    response.completion_response_id,
    response.completion_submitted_at,
    COALESCE(response.services_performed, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS services_performed,
    response.cleaning_note,
    COALESCE(ticket.ticket_count, 0) AS maintenance_ticket_count,
    COALESCE(ticket.open_ticket_count, 0) AS open_maintenance_ticket_count,
    COALESCE(ticket.issue_categories, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS maintenance_issue_categories,
    COALESCE(ticket.fixture_identifiers, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS maintenance_fixture_identifiers,
    COALESCE(inspection.inspection_count, 0) AS inspection_count,
    inspection.inspection_score_total,
    inspection.average_inspection_score,
    COALESCE(inspection.inspection_pass_count, 0) AS inspection_pass_count,
    inspection.latest_inspection_score,
    inspection.latest_inspection_passed,
    inspection.latest_inspected_at,
    inspection.latest_inspection_notes
   FROM sessions s
     JOIN locations l ON l.id = s.location_id
     JOIN employees e ON e.id = s.employee_id
     JOIN devices d ON d.id = s.device_id
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT cr.id AS completion_response_id,
            cr.submitted_at AS completion_submitted_at,
            COALESCE(( SELECT array_agg(svc.value ORDER BY svc.ordinality) AS array_agg
                   FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(
                        CASE
                            WHEN jsonb_typeof(cr.response_json -> 'services_performed'::text) = 'array'::text THEN cr.response_json -> 'services_performed'::text
                            ELSE '[]'::jsonb
                        END) WITH ORDINALITY svc(value, ordinality)), ARRAY[]::text[]) AS services_performed,
            NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(cr.response_json ->> 'note'::text, cr.response_json ->> 'notes'::text, ''::text)), ''::text) AS cleaning_note
           FROM completion_responses cr
          WHERE cr.session_id = s.id
          ORDER BY cr.submitted_at DESC, cr.id DESC
         LIMIT 1) response ON true
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*)::integer AS ticket_count,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE lower(COALESCE(mt.status, 'open'::text)) = 'open'::text)::integer AS open_ticket_count,
            COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(btrim(mt.issue_category), ''::text)) FILTER (WHERE NULLIF(btrim(mt.issue_category), ''::text) IS NOT NULL), ARRAY[]::text[]) AS issue_categories,
            COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF(btrim(mt.fixture_identifier), ''::text)) FILTER (WHERE NULLIF(btrim(mt.fixture_identifier), ''::text) IS NOT NULL), ARRAY[]::text[]) AS fixture_identifiers
           FROM maintenance_tickets mt
          WHERE mt.session_id = s.id) ticket ON true
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*)::integer AS inspection_count,
            sum(ci.overall_score)::numeric AS inspection_score_total,
            round(avg(ci.overall_score), 1) AS average_inspection_score,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE ci.passed)::integer AS inspection_pass_count,
            (array_agg(ci.overall_score ORDER BY ci.inspected_at DESC, ci.id DESC))[1] AS latest_inspection_score,
            (array_agg(ci.passed ORDER BY ci.inspected_at DESC, ci.id DESC))[1] AS latest_inspection_passed,
            max(ci.inspected_at) AS latest_inspected_at,
            (array_agg(ci.notes ORDER BY ci.inspected_at DESC, ci.id DESC))[1] AS latest_inspection_notes
           FROM cleaning_inspections ci
          WHERE ci.session_id = s.id) inspection ON true;

views.comment: Shows original immutable cleaning evidence beside the latest append-only corrected manager truth.
views.definition:
SELECT s.id AS session_id,
    s.session_uuid,
    s.client_session_id,
    s.status,
    s.employee_id AS original_employee_id,
    s.employee_name_snapshot AS original_employee_name,
    s.location_id AS original_location_id,
    s.location_code_snapshot AS original_location_code,
    s.location_name_snapshot AS original_location_name,
    s.device_id AS original_device_id,
    s.device_identifier_snapshot AS original_device_identifier,
    s.device_name_snapshot AS original_device_name,
    s.assignment_epoch_snapshot AS original_assignment_epoch,
    s.started_at AS original_started_at,
    s.ended_at AS original_ended_at,
    COALESCE(c.effective_employee_id, s.employee_id) AS current_employee_id,
    COALESCE(c.effective_employee_name_snapshot, s.employee_name_snapshot) AS current_employee_name,
    COALESCE(c.effective_location_id, s.location_id) AS current_location_id,
    COALESCE(c.effective_location_code_snapshot, s.location_code_snapshot) AS current_location_code,
    COALESCE(c.effective_location_name_snapshot, s.location_name_snapshot) AS current_location_name,
    COALESCE(c.effective_device_id, s.device_id) AS current_device_id,
    COALESCE(c.effective_device_identifier_snapshot, s.device_identifier_snapshot) AS current_device_identifier,
    COALESCE(c.effective_device_name_snapshot, s.device_name_snapshot) AS current_device_name,
    COALESCE(c.effective_assignment_epoch_snapshot, s.assignment_epoch_snapshot) AS current_assignment_epoch,
    COALESCE(c.effective_started_at, s.started_at) AS current_started_at,
    COALESCE(c.effective_ended_at, s.ended_at) AS current_ended_at,
    c.correction_id,
    c.corrected_by_manager_id,
    c.corrected_by_manager_name_snapshot,
    c.reason AS correction_reason,
    c.changed_fields,
    c.created_at AS corrected_at
   FROM sessions s
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT c_1.correction_id,
            c_1.operation_id,
            c_1.request_fingerprint,
            c_1.session_id,
            c_1.corrected_by_manager_id,
            c_1.corrected_by_manager_name_snapshot,
            c_1.reason,
            c_1.changed_fields,
            c_1.effective_employee_id,
            c_1.effective_employee_name_snapshot,
            c_1.effective_location_id,
            c_1.effective_location_code_snapshot,
            c_1.effective_location_name_snapshot,
            c_1.effective_device_id,
            c_1.effective_device_identifier_snapshot,
            c_1.effective_device_name_snapshot,
            c_1.effective_assignment_epoch_snapshot,
            c_1.effective_started_at,
            c_1.effective_ended_at,
            c_1.created_at
           FROM custodial_session_corrections c_1
          WHERE c_1.session_id = s.id
          ORDER BY c_1.created_at DESC, c_1.correction_id DESC
         LIMIT 1) c ON true;

SELECT DISTINCT ON (dsa.service_date, l.id, dsa.assigned_employee_id, dsa.coverage_purpose) dsa.service_date,
    LEAST(dsa.coverage_start, '05:15:00'::time without time zone) AS coverage_start,
    GREATEST(dsa.coverage_end, '16:00:00'::time without time zone) AS coverage_end,
    dsa.coverage_purpose,
    lg.group_name,
    l.id AS location_id,
    l.location_code,
    l.location_name,
    l.form_type,
    COALESCE(l.sort_order, 999999) AS sort_order,
    e.id AS employee_id,
    e.display_name AS employee_name
   FROM daily_schedule_assignments dsa
     JOIN location_groups lg ON lg.id = dsa.location_group_id AND lg.active = true
     JOIN location_group_memberships lgm ON lgm.location_group_id = dsa.location_group_id AND lgm.active = true
     JOIN locations l ON l.id = lgm.location_id AND l.active = true
     JOIN employees e ON e.id = dsa.assigned_employee_id AND e.active = true
  WHERE dsa.status = 'ASSIGNED'::text AND dsa.assigned_employee_id IS NOT NULL AND dsa.coverage_purpose <> 'late_coverage'::text AND (l.form_type = ANY (ARRAY['restroom'::text, 'exhibit'::text]))
  ORDER BY dsa.service_date, l.id, dsa.assigned_employee_id, dsa.coverage_purpose, dsa.coverage_start;

SELECT d.id AS device_pk,
    d.device_id,
    d.device_name,
    d.active,
    d.last_seen_at,
        CASE
            WHEN d.last_seen_at IS NULL THEN 'Never seen'::text
            ELSE to_char(timezone('America/Chicago'::text, d.last_seen_at), 'MM/DD/YYYY HH12:MI AM'::text) || ' Central'::text
        END AS last_seen_at_display,
    now() - d.last_seen_at AS last_seen_age,
        CASE
            WHEN d.last_seen_at IS NULL THEN 'never_seen'::text
            WHEN d.last_seen_at >= (now() - '01:00:00'::interval) THEN 'healthy'::text
            WHEN d.last_seen_at >= (now() - '24:00:00'::interval) THEN 'stale'::text
            ELSE 'offline'::text
        END AS health_status,
    e.display_name AS assigned_employee_name
   FROM devices d
     LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.id = d.assigned_employee_id
  WHERE d.active = true;

SELECT 'open_ticket'::text AS exception_type,
    ticket.ticket_id::text AS entity_id,
    ticket.location_code,
    ticket.location_name,
    ticket.date_submitted AS event_at,
    ticket.date_submitted_display AS event_at_display,
    ticket.maintenance_issue AS summary,
    ticket.reported_by AS actor,
    jsonb_build_object('fixture_type', ticket.fixture_type, 'fixture_identifier', ticket.fixture_identifier, 'out_of_order', ticket.out_of_order, 'status', ticket.status) AS details
   FROM v_open_maintenance_tickets ticket
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'overdue_location'::text AS exception_type,
    location.location_id::text AS entity_id,
    location.location_code,
    location.location_name,
    location.latest_completed_at AS event_at,
    location.latest_completed_at_display AS event_at_display,
    'Location overdue for cleaning'::text AS summary,
    location.latest_employee_name AS actor,
    jsonb_build_object('form_type', location.form_type, 'status_code', location.status_code, 'status_color', location.status_color, 'open_ticket_count', location.open_ticket_count) AS details
   FROM v_location_dashboard_status location
  WHERE location.status_code = 'overdue'::text
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'stale_device'::text AS exception_type,
    device.id::text AS entity_id,
    NULL::text AS location_code,
    device.device_name AS location_name,
    GREATEST(device.last_seen_at, sync.last_server_ack_at, sync.updated_at) AS event_at,
        CASE
            WHEN GREATEST(device.last_seen_at, sync.last_server_ack_at, sync.updated_at) IS NULL THEN 'Never seen'::text
            ELSE to_char(timezone('America/Chicago'::text, GREATEST(device.last_seen_at, sync.last_server_ack_at, sync.updated_at)), 'MM/DD/YYYY HH12:MI AM'::text) || ' Central'::text
        END AS event_at_display,
    'Device missing recent heartbeat'::text AS summary,
    device.device_id AS actor,
    jsonb_build_object('device_id', device.device_id, 'active', device.active, 'last_seen_at', device.last_seen_at, 'last_server_ack_at', sync.last_server_ack_at, 'sync_updated_at', sync.updated_at) AS details
   FROM devices device
     LEFT JOIN device_sync_status sync ON sync.device_id = device.id
  WHERE device.active = true AND device.assigned_employee_id IS NOT NULL AND (GREATEST(device.last_seen_at, sync.last_server_ack_at, sync.updated_at) IS NULL OR GREATEST(device.last_seen_at, sync.last_server_ack_at, sync.updated_at) < (now() - '24:00:00'::interval))
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'stale_open_session'::text AS exception_type,
    work.session_uuid AS entity_id,
    work.location_code,
    work.location_name,
    COALESCE(work.ended_at, work.started_at) AS event_at,
    to_char(timezone('America/Chicago'::text, COALESCE(work.ended_at, work.started_at)), 'MM/DD/YYYY HH12:MI AM'::text) || ' Central'::text AS event_at_display,
    'Open session exceeded stale timeout'::text AS summary,
    work.employee_name AS actor,
    jsonb_build_object('status', work.status, 'device_id', work.device_identifier, 'started_at', work.started_at, 'ended_at', work.ended_at) AS details
   FROM custodial_open_work() work(open_work_id, source_kind, session_id, context_id, session_uuid, client_session_id, location_id, location_code, location_name, employee_id, employee_name, device_id, device_identifier, status, started_at, ended_at, duration_minutes, duration_display, created_at)
  WHERE COALESCE(work.ended_at, work.started_at) <= (now() - make_interval(mins => get_setting_int('stale_session_timeout_minutes'::text, 120)));

SELECT l.id AS location_id,
    l.location_code,
    l.location_name,
    l.location_type,
    s.id AS session_id,
    s.session_uuid,
    s.status,
    s.started_at,
    s.ended_at,
    s.duration_minutes,
    s.duration_display,
    e.id AS employee_id,
    e.display_name AS cleaned_by,
    d.id AS device_pk,
    d.device_id,
    row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY l.id ORDER BY s.started_at DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn
   FROM locations l
     LEFT JOIN sessions s ON s.location_id = l.id AND s.status = 'closed'::text
     LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.id = s.employee_id
     LEFT JOIN devices d ON d.id = s.device_id;

WITH op_day AS (
         SELECT operational_day_start(now()) AS day_start,
            sch_service_date(now()) AS service_date
        ), authority AS (
         SELECT state.service_date,
            state.governed,
            state.authority_source,
            state.projection_status,
            state.version_id,
            state.publication_id,
            state.projection_id,
            state.projection_authority_revision,
            state.staffing_authority_revision,
            state.week_start
           FROM op_day day
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL static_weekly_v6_schedule_authority_state(day.service_date) state(service_date, governed, authority_source, projection_status, version_id, publication_id, projection_id, projection_authority_revision, staffing_authority_revision, week_start)
        ), scheduled_baseline AS (
         SELECT assignment.location_id,
            min(((day.service_date + assignment.coverage_start) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago'::text)) AS baseline_at
           FROM op_day day
             JOIN LATERAL custodial_operational_location_assignments(day.service_date) assignment(service_date, authority_source, projection_status, version_id, publication_id, projection_id, occurrence_id, location_group_id, group_code, group_name, assigned_employee_id, assigned_employee_name, assignment_status, coverage_start, coverage_end, location_id, location_code, location_name, form_type) ON true
          GROUP BY assignment.location_id
        ), latest_scan AS (
         SELECT scan_events.location_id,
            max(COALESCE(scan_events.scanned_at, scan_events.created_at)) AS last_scan_at
           FROM scan_events
          GROUP BY scan_events.location_id
        ), open_session AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (work.location_id) work.location_id,
            work.location_code,
            work.session_id,
            work.session_uuid,
            work.status AS session_status,
            work.started_at,
            work.ended_at,
            work.duration_minutes,
            work.duration_display,
            work.employee_name,
            work.device_identifier
           FROM custodial_open_work() work(open_work_id, source_kind, session_id, context_id, session_uuid, client_session_id, location_id, location_code, location_name, employee_id, employee_name, device_id, device_identifier, status, started_at, ended_at, duration_minutes, duration_display, created_at)
          WHERE work.source_kind <> 'session'::text OR work.started_at >= operational_day_start(now())
          ORDER BY work.location_id, work.started_at DESC, work.created_at DESC, work.open_work_id DESC
        ), latest_completed AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (session.location_id) session.location_id,
            session.id AS session_id,
            session.session_uuid,
            session.started_at,
            session.ended_at,
            session.duration_minutes,
            session.duration_display,
            employee.display_name AS employee_name,
            completion.submitted_at,
            completion.response_json,
            COALESCE(session.ended_at, completion.submitted_at, session.started_at) AS effective_completed_at
           FROM sessions session
             JOIN employees employee ON employee.id = session.employee_id
             LEFT JOIN completion_responses completion ON completion.session_id = session.id
             CROSS JOIN op_day day
          WHERE session.status = 'closed'::text AND (completion.response_json ->> 'work_result'::text) IS DISTINCT FROM 'checked_no_cleaning_needed'::text AND COALESCE(session.ended_at, completion.submitted_at, session.started_at) >= day.day_start
          ORDER BY session.location_id, (COALESCE(session.ended_at, completion.submitted_at, session.started_at)) DESC, session.started_at DESC
        ), open_tickets AS (
         SELECT maintenance_tickets.location_id,
            count(*) AS open_ticket_count
           FROM maintenance_tickets
          WHERE maintenance_tickets.status = 'open'::text
          GROUP BY maintenance_tickets.location_id
        ), truth AS (
         SELECT location.id AS location_id,
            COALESCE(open_session.location_code, location.location_code) AS location_code,
            place_operational_location_name(location.id, statement_timestamp()) AS location_name,
            location.location_type,
            location.form_type,
            day.day_start,
            latest_scan.last_scan_at,
            open_session.session_id AS open_session_id,
            open_session.session_uuid AS open_session_uuid,
            open_session.session_status AS open_session_status,
            open_session.started_at AS open_session_started_at,
            open_session.ended_at AS open_session_ended_at,
            open_session.employee_name AS open_session_employee_name,
            open_session.device_identifier AS open_session_device_identifier,
            latest_completed.session_id AS latest_completed_session_id,
            latest_completed.session_uuid AS latest_completed_session_uuid,
            latest_completed.started_at AS latest_started_at,
            latest_completed.ended_at AS latest_ended_at,
            latest_completed.submitted_at AS latest_submitted_at,
            latest_completed.effective_completed_at AS latest_completed_at,
            latest_completed.employee_name AS latest_employee_name,
            latest_completed.duration_minutes,
            latest_completed.duration_display,
            latest_completed.response_json,
            COALESCE(open_tickets.open_ticket_count, 0::bigint) AS open_ticket_count,
            scheduled_baseline.baseline_at,
            mz_latest_verified_check(location.id, day.day_start, now()) AS verified_check_at,
                CASE
                    WHEN latest_completed.effective_completed_at IS NULL THEN NULL::timestamp with time zone
                    ELSE GREATEST(latest_completed.effective_completed_at, mz_latest_verified_check(location.id, day.day_start, now()))
                END AS due_baseline_at,
            authority.authority_source AS schedule_authority_source,
            authority.projection_status AS schedule_projection_status
           FROM locations location
             CROSS JOIN op_day day
             CROSS JOIN authority
             LEFT JOIN scheduled_baseline ON scheduled_baseline.location_id = location.id
             LEFT JOIN latest_scan ON latest_scan.location_id = location.id
             LEFT JOIN open_session ON open_session.location_id = location.id
             LEFT JOIN latest_completed ON latest_completed.location_id = location.id
             LEFT JOIN open_tickets ON open_tickets.location_id = location.id
          WHERE location.active = true
        )
 SELECT location_id,
    location_code,
    location_name,
    location_type,
    form_type,
    day_start AS operational_day_start,
    last_scan_at,
    open_session_id,
    open_session_uuid,
    open_session_status,
    open_session_started_at,
    open_session_ended_at,
    latest_completed_session_id,
    latest_completed_session_uuid,
    latest_started_at,
    latest_ended_at,
    latest_submitted_at,
    latest_completed_at,
    latest_employee_name,
    duration_minutes,
    duration_display,
    COALESCE(response_json -> 'services_performed'::text, response_json -> 'servicesPerformed'::text, response_json -> 'services'::text, response_json -> 'completed_services'::text, response_json -> 'completedServices'::text, '[]'::jsonb) AS services_performed,
    COALESCE(response_json ->> 'notes'::text, response_json ->> 'cleaning_notes'::text, response_json ->> 'cleaningNotes'::text, response_json ->> 'maintenance_notes'::text, response_json ->> 'maintenanceNotes'::text, response_json ->> 'other_service_performed'::text, response_json ->> 'otherServicePerformed'::text, response_json ->> 'note'::text) AS notes,
    open_ticket_count,
        CASE
            WHEN due_baseline_at IS NULL AND (open_session_status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'pending_submit'::text])) THEN 'in_progress'::text
            WHEN due_baseline_at IS NULL THEN 'not_cleaned'::text
            WHEN form_type = 'restroom'::text AND now() >= (due_baseline_at + make_interval(mins =>
            CASE
                WHEN mz_is_approved_admin_location(location_id, now()) THEN 180
                ELSE get_setting_int('restroom_overdue_minutes'::text, 90)
            END)) THEN 'overdue'::text
            WHEN form_type = 'restroom'::text AND now() >= (due_baseline_at + make_interval(mins =>
            CASE
                WHEN mz_is_approved_admin_location(location_id, now()) THEN 165
                ELSE get_setting_int('restroom_due_soon_minutes'::text, 75)
            END)) THEN 'due_soon'::text
            WHEN form_type = 'exhibit'::text AND now() >= (due_baseline_at + make_interval(mins =>
            CASE
                WHEN mz_is_approved_admin_location(location_id, now()) THEN 180
                ELSE get_setting_int('exhibit_overdue_minutes'::text, 210)
            END)) THEN 'overdue'::text
            WHEN form_type = 'exhibit'::text AND now() >= (due_baseline_at + make_interval(mins =>
            CASE
                WHEN mz_is_approved_admin_location(location_id, now()) THEN 165
                ELSE get_setting_int('exhibit_due_soon_minutes'::text, 195)
            END)) THEN 'due_soon'::text
            WHEN open_session_status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'pending_submit'::text]) THEN 'in_progress'::text
            ELSE 'okay'::text
        END AS status_code,
        CASE
            WHEN due_baseline_at IS NULL AND (open_session_status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'pending_submit'::text])) THEN 'blue'::text
            WHEN due_baseline_at IS NULL THEN 'black'::text
            WHEN form_type = 'restroom'::text AND now() >= (due_baseline_at + make_interval(mins =>
            CASE
                WHEN mz_is_approved_admin_location(location_id, now()) THEN 180
                ELSE get_setting_int('restroom_overdue_minutes'::text, 90)
            END)) OR form_type = 'exhibit'::text AND now() >= (due_baseline_at + make_interval(mins =>
            CASE
                WHEN mz_is_approved_admin_location(location_id, now()) THEN 180
                ELSE get_setting_int('exhibit_overdue_minutes'::text, 210)
            END)) THEN 'red'::text
            WHEN form_type = 'restroom'::text AND now() >= (due_baseline_at + make_interval(mins =>
            CASE
                WHEN mz_is_approved_admin_location(location_id, now()) THEN 165
                ELSE get_setting_int('restroom_due_soon_minutes'::text, 75)
            END)) OR form_type = 'exhibit'::text AND now() >= (due_baseline_at + make_interval(mins =>
            CASE
                WHEN mz_is_approved_admin_location(location_id, now()) THEN 165
                ELSE get_setting_int('exhibit_due_soon_minutes'::text, 195)
            END)) THEN 'yellow'::text
            WHEN open_session_status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'pending_submit'::text]) THEN 'blue'::text
            ELSE 'green'::text
        END AS status_color,
    to_char(timezone('America/Chicago'::text, day_start), 'MM/DD/YYYY HH12:MI AM'::text) || ' Central'::text AS operational_day_start_display,
    to_char(timezone('America/Chicago'::text, last_scan_at), 'MM/DD/YYYY HH12:MI AM'::text) || ' Central'::text AS last_scan_at_display,
    to_char(timezone('America/Chicago'::text, open_session_started_at), 'MM/DD/YYYY HH12:MI AM'::text) || ' Central'::text AS open_session_started_at_display,
    to_char(timezone('America/Chicago'::text, open_session_ended_at), 'MM/DD/YYYY HH12:MI AM'::text) || ' Central'::text AS open_session_ended_at_display,
    to_char(timezone('America/Chicago'::text, latest_started_at), 'MM/DD/YYYY HH12:MI AM'::text) || ' Central'::text AS latest_started_at_display,
    to_char(timezone('America/Chicago'::text, latest_ended_at), 'MM/DD/YYYY HH12:MI AM'::text) || ' Central'::text AS latest_ended_at_display,
    to_char(timezone('America/Chicago'::text, latest_submitted_at), 'MM/DD/YYYY HH12:MI AM'::text) || ' Central'::text AS latest_submitted_at_display,
    to_char(timezone('America/Chicago'::text, latest_completed_at), 'MM/DD/YYYY HH12:MI AM'::text) || ' Central'::text AS latest_completed_at_display,
    open_session_employee_name,
    open_session_device_identifier,
    schedule_authority_source,
    schedule_projection_status,
    GREATEST(latest_completed_at, verified_check_at) AS latest_checked_at
   FROM truth;

WITH work_candidates AS (
         SELECT work.location_id,
            work.location_code,
            work.session_id,
            work.session_uuid,
            work.status AS session_status,
            work.started_at,
            work.ended_at,
            work.duration_minutes,
            work.duration_display,
            work.employee_name,
            work.device_identifier AS device_id,
            work.created_at,
            0 AS source_priority
           FROM custodial_open_work() work(open_work_id, source_kind, session_id, context_id, session_uuid, client_session_id, location_id, location_code, location_name, employee_id, employee_name, device_id, device_identifier, status, started_at, ended_at, duration_minutes, duration_display, created_at)
          WHERE work.source_kind <> 'session'::text OR work.started_at >= operational_day_start(now())
        UNION ALL
         SELECT session.location_id,
            NULL::text AS text,
            session.id,
            session.session_uuid,
            session.status,
            session.started_at,
            session.ended_at,
            session.duration_minutes,
            session.duration_display,
            employee.display_name,
            device.device_id,
            session.created_at,
            1 AS source_priority
           FROM sessions session
             LEFT JOIN employees employee ON employee.id = session.employee_id
             LEFT JOIN devices device ON device.id = session.device_id
          WHERE session.status <> ALL (ARRAY['active'::text, 'pending_submit'::text])
        ), ranked AS (
         SELECT location.id AS location_id,
            COALESCE(work.location_code, location.location_code) AS location_code,
            location.location_name,
            location.location_type,
            location.active AS location_active,
            work.session_id,
            work.session_uuid,
            work.session_status,
            work.started_at,
            work.ended_at,
            work.duration_minutes,
            work.duration_display,
            work.employee_name,
            work.device_id,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY location.id ORDER BY work.source_priority, work.started_at DESC NULLS LAST, work.created_at DESC NULLS LAST, work.session_id DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn
           FROM locations location
             LEFT JOIN work_candidates work ON work.location_id = location.id
        )
 SELECT location_id,
    location_code,
    location_name,
    location_type,
    location_active,
    session_id,
    session_uuid,
    session_status,
    started_at,
    ended_at,
    duration_minutes,
    duration_display,
    employee_name,
    device_id
   FROM ranked
  WHERE rn = 1;

views.comment: Recurring maintenance issue and fixture trends across 7, 30, 90 day, and lifetime windows.
views.definition:
WITH normalized AS (
         SELECT mt.id,
            mt.completion_response_id,
            mt.session_id,
            mt.location_id,
            mt.reported_by_employee_id,
            mt.device_id,
            mt.issue_source,
            mt.status,
            mt.issue_summary,
            mt.issue_category,
            mt.fixture_type,
            mt.fixture_identifier,
            mt.out_of_order,
            mt.issue_payload,
            mt.location_code_snapshot,
            mt.location_name_snapshot,
            mt.reporter_name_snapshot,
            mt.reported_at,
            mt.created_at,
            mt.closed_at,
            mt.closed_by,
            mt.close_notes,
            mt.closed_via,
            lower(COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(mt.issue_category), ''::text), 'uncategorized'::text)) AS issue_category_key,
            lower(COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(mt.fixture_type), ''::text), 'unspecified'::text)) AS fixture_type_key,
            lower(COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(mt.fixture_identifier), ''::text), 'unspecified'::text)) AS fixture_identifier_key
           FROM maintenance_tickets mt
        ), grouped AS (
         SELECT normalized.location_id,
            max(normalized.location_code_snapshot) AS location_code,
            max(normalized.location_name_snapshot) AS location_name,
            normalized.issue_category_key,
            max(NULLIF(btrim(normalized.issue_category), ''::text)) AS issue_category,
            normalized.fixture_type_key,
            max(NULLIF(btrim(normalized.fixture_type), ''::text)) AS fixture_type,
            normalized.fixture_identifier_key,
            max(NULLIF(btrim(normalized.fixture_identifier), ''::text)) AS fixture_identifier,
            count(*)::integer AS total_ticket_count,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE normalized.reported_at >= (now() - '7 days'::interval))::integer AS ticket_count_last_7_days,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE normalized.reported_at >= (now() - '30 days'::interval))::integer AS ticket_count_last_30_days,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE normalized.reported_at >= (now() - '90 days'::interval))::integer AS ticket_count_last_90_days,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE lower(COALESCE(normalized.status, 'open'::text)) = 'open'::text)::integer AS open_ticket_count,
            min(normalized.reported_at) AS first_reported_at,
            max(normalized.reported_at) AS latest_reported_at,
            round(avg(EXTRACT(epoch FROM normalized.closed_at - normalized.reported_at) / 3600.0) FILTER (WHERE normalized.closed_at IS NOT NULL), 1) AS average_resolution_hours
           FROM normalized
          GROUP BY normalized.location_id, normalized.issue_category_key, normalized.fixture_type_key, normalized.fixture_identifier_key
        )
 SELECT location_id,
    location_code,
    location_name,
    issue_category_key,
    issue_category,
    fixture_type_key,
    fixture_type,
    fixture_identifier_key,
    fixture_identifier,
    total_ticket_count,
    ticket_count_last_7_days,
    ticket_count_last_30_days,
    ticket_count_last_90_days,
    open_ticket_count,
    first_reported_at,
    latest_reported_at,
    average_resolution_hours,
    md5((((((COALESCE(location_id::text, ''::text) || '|'::text) || issue_category_key) || '|'::text) || fixture_type_key) || '|'::text) || fixture_identifier_key) AS issue_signature,
        CASE
            WHEN ticket_count_last_7_days >= 3 THEN 'hotspot'::text
            WHEN ticket_count_last_30_days >= 3 THEN 'recurring'::text
            WHEN total_ticket_count >= 2 THEN 'repeat'::text
            ELSE 'isolated'::text
        END AS recurrence_status
   FROM grouped g;

SELECT dao.absence_date AS service_date,
    dao.employee_id AS absent_employee_id,
    ae.display_name AS absent_employee_name,
    dsa.group_code,
    dsa.group_name,
    dsa.segment_number,
    dsa.coverage_start,
    dsa.coverage_end,
    dsa.assigned_employee_id,
    dsa.assigned_employee_name,
        CASE
            WHEN dsa.status = 'ASSIGNED'::text THEN 'COVERED'::text
            ELSE 'OPEN'::text
        END AS coverage_status,
        CASE
            WHEN dsa.status = 'ASSIGNED'::text THEN COALESCE(dsa.source_type, 'assigned'::text)
            ELSE 'open_no_coverage'::text
        END AS reassignment_reason,
    dsa.notes
   FROM daily_absence_overrides dao
     JOIN employees ae ON ae.id = dao.employee_id
     LEFT JOIN v_memphis_area_schedule dsa ON dsa.service_date = dao.absence_date AND dsa.notes ~~* (('%'::text || ae.display_name) || '%'::text)
  WHERE dao.active = true;

WITH authority_dates AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT occurrence.service_date
           FROM weekly_schedule_occurrences occurrence
        UNION
         SELECT DISTINCT assignment.service_date
           FROM daily_schedule_assignments assignment
        UNION
         SELECT custodial_dated_service_dates.service_date
           FROM custodial_dated_service_dates() custodial_dated_service_dates(service_date)
        )
 SELECT segment.service_date,
    segment.location_group_id,
    segment.group_code,
    segment.group_name,
    segment.segment_number,
    segment.assigned_employee_id,
    segment.assigned_employee_name,
    employee.employee_code,
    "left"(segment.coverage_start, 5) AS coverage_start,
    "left"(segment.coverage_end, 5) AS coverage_end,
    segment.status,
    segment.owner_type,
    segment.load_points::numeric(10,2) AS load_points,
    segment.source_type,
    segment.notes
   FROM authority_dates authority_date
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL static_weekly_v6_read_schedule_segments(authority_date.service_date) segment(service_date, location_group_id, group_code, group_name, included_locations, included_location_ids, segment_id, segment_number, owner_type, assigned_employee_id, assigned_employee_name, coverage_start, coverage_end, status, load_points, coverage_purpose, notes, source_type, service_mode, governed, projection_status, version_id, publication_id, projection_id)
     LEFT JOIN employees employee ON employee.id = segment.assigned_employee_id;

SELECT service_date,
    assigned_employee_id AS employee_id,
    assigned_employee_name AS employee_name,
    employee_code,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'ASSIGNED'::text)::integer AS assigned_segments,
    COALESCE(sum(load_points) FILTER (WHERE status = 'ASSIGNED'::text), 0::numeric) AS assigned_load_points,
    COALESCE(sum(EXTRACT(epoch FROM coverage_end::time without time zone - coverage_start::time without time zone) / 60::numeric) FILTER (WHERE status = 'ASSIGNED'::text), 0::numeric) AS assigned_minutes,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'ASSIGNED'::text AND COALESCE(source_type, ''::text) ~~ '%auto_reassigned%'::text)::integer AS open_gap_coverage_count
   FROM v_memphis_area_schedule area
  WHERE assigned_employee_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY service_date, assigned_employee_id, assigned_employee_name, employee_code;

SELECT service_date,
    assigned_employee_id AS employee_id,
    assigned_employee_name AS employee_name,
    employee_code,
    location_group_id,
    group_code,
    group_name,
    segment_number,
    coverage_start,
    coverage_end,
    status,
    owner_type,
    load_points,
    source_type,
    notes
   FROM v_memphis_area_schedule area
  WHERE assigned_employee_id IS NOT NULL;

SELECT service_date,
    location_group_id,
    group_code,
    group_name,
    segment_number,
    coverage_start,
    coverage_end,
    notes,
        CASE
            WHEN notes ~~* '%off%'::text THEN 'template owner off'::text
            WHEN notes ~~* '%absent%'::text THEN 'absence impact'::text
            WHEN source_type ~~* '%open%'::text THEN 'open coverage'::text
            ELSE 'no active coverage'::text
        END AS reason_open
   FROM v_memphis_area_schedule area
  WHERE status = 'OPEN'::text;

SELECT mt.id AS ticket_id,
    COALESCE(mt.location_code_snapshot, l.location_code) AS location_code,
    COALESCE(mt.location_name_snapshot, l.location_name) AS location_name,
    mt.reported_at AS date_submitted,
    mt.issue_summary AS maintenance_issue,
    COALESCE(mt.reporter_name_snapshot, e.display_name) AS reported_by,
    mt.fixture_type,
    mt.fixture_identifier,
    mt.out_of_order,
    mt.status,
    mt.issue_payload,
    mt.close_notes,
    mt.created_at,
    to_char(timezone('America/Chicago'::text, mt.reported_at), 'MM/DD/YYYY'::text) AS date_submitted_date_display,
    to_char(timezone('America/Chicago'::text, mt.reported_at), 'MM/DD/YYYY HH12:MI AM'::text) || ' Central'::text AS date_submitted_display,
    to_char(timezone('America/Chicago'::text, mt.created_at), 'MM/DD/YYYY HH12:MI AM'::text) || ' Central'::text AS created_at_display,
    mt.issue_source
   FROM maintenance_tickets mt
     LEFT JOIN locations l ON l.id = mt.location_id
     LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.id = mt.reported_by_employee_id
  WHERE mt.status = 'open'::text;

SELECT s.session_uuid,
    l.location_code,
    l.location_name,
    l.form_type,
    e.display_name AS employee_name,
    d.device_id AS device_identifier,
    d.device_name,
    s.status,
    s.started_at,
    to_char(timezone('America/Chicago'::text, s.started_at), 'MM/DD/YYYY HH12:MI AM'::text) || ' Central'::text AS started_at_display,
    s.ended_at,
    to_char(timezone('America/Chicago'::text, s.ended_at), 'MM/DD/YYYY HH12:MI AM'::text) || ' Central'::text AS ended_at_display,
    cr.submitted_at,
    to_char(timezone('America/Chicago'::text, cr.submitted_at), 'MM/DD/YYYY HH12:MI AM'::text) || ' Central'::text AS submitted_at_display,
    s.duration_minutes,
    s.duration_display,
    COALESCE(cr.response_json -> 'services_performed'::text, cr.response_json -> 'servicesPerformed'::text, cr.response_json -> 'services'::text, cr.response_json -> 'completed_services'::text, cr.response_json -> 'completedServices'::text, '[]'::jsonb) AS services_performed,
    COALESCE(cr.response_json ->> 'notes'::text, cr.response_json ->> 'cleaning_notes'::text, cr.response_json ->> 'cleaningNotes'::text, cr.response_json ->> 'maintenance_notes'::text, cr.response_json ->> 'maintenanceNotes'::text, cr.response_json ->> 'other_service_performed'::text, cr.response_json ->> 'otherServicePerformed'::text, cr.response_json ->> 'note'::text) AS notes,
    COALESCE(mt.open_ticket_count, 0::bigint) AS open_ticket_count
   FROM sessions s
     JOIN locations l ON l.id = s.location_id
     JOIN employees e ON e.id = s.employee_id
     LEFT JOIN devices d ON d.id = s.device_id
     LEFT JOIN completion_responses cr ON cr.session_id = s.id
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT maintenance_tickets.session_id,
            count(*) AS open_ticket_count
           FROM maintenance_tickets
          WHERE maintenance_tickets.status = 'open'::text
          GROUP BY maintenance_tickets.session_id) mt ON mt.session_id = s.id
  ORDER BY (COALESCE(cr.submitted_at, s.ended_at, s.started_at)) DESC, s.created_at DESC;

WITH restroom_locations AS (
         SELECT group_row.id AS location_group_id,
            group_row.group_code,
            group_row.group_name,
            location.id AS location_id,
            location.location_code,
            location.location_name
           FROM location_groups group_row
             JOIN location_group_memberships membership ON membership.location_group_id = group_row.id AND membership.active = true
             JOIN locations location ON location.id = membership.location_id AND location.active = true
          WHERE group_row.active = true AND lower(COALESCE(location.form_type, location.location_type, ''::text)) = 'restroom'::text AND sch_is_public_restroom_group(group_row.id) AND NOT (location.location_name ~~* '%East Admin%'::text OR location.location_name ~~* '%West Admin%'::text OR location.location_name ~~* '%Elephant Trunk%'::text)
        ), activity AS (
         SELECT session.location_id,
            COALESCE(session.ended_at, completion.submitted_at, session.started_at) AS activity_at,
            COALESCE(submitter.display_name, employee.display_name) AS actor_name,
            COALESCE(completion_device.device_id, device.device_id) AS device_identifier
           FROM sessions session
             LEFT JOIN completion_responses completion ON completion.session_id = session.id
             LEFT JOIN employees submitter ON submitter.id = completion.submitted_by_employee_id
             LEFT JOIN employees employee ON employee.id = session.employee_id
             LEFT JOIN devices completion_device ON completion_device.id = completion.device_id
             LEFT JOIN devices device ON device.id = session.device_id
          WHERE COALESCE(session.ended_at, completion.submitted_at, session.started_at) >= operational_day_start(now()) AND session.status = 'closed'::text AND ((completion.response_json ->> 'work_result'::text) IS DISTINCT FROM 'checked_no_cleaning_needed'::text OR session.ended_at = mz_latest_verified_check(session.location_id, operational_day_start(now()), now()))
        ), latest_completion AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (restroom_1.location_id) restroom_1.location_id,
            activity.activity_at AS last_completed_at,
            activity.actor_name AS last_completed_by,
            activity.device_identifier AS last_completed_device
           FROM restroom_locations restroom_1
             LEFT JOIN activity ON activity.location_id = restroom_1.location_id
          ORDER BY restroom_1.location_id, activity.activity_at DESC NULLS LAST
        ), current_owner AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (assignment.location_group_id) assignment.location_group_id,
            assignment.assigned_employee_id,
            employee.display_name AS assigned_owner,
            assignment.coverage_start::time without time zone AS coverage_start,
            assignment.coverage_end::time without time zone AS coverage_end,
            assignment.coverage_purpose,
            assignment.status
           FROM static_weekly_v6_read_schedule_segments(sch_service_date(now())) assignment(service_date, location_group_id, group_code, group_name, included_locations, included_location_ids, segment_id, segment_number, owner_type, assigned_employee_id, assigned_employee_name, coverage_start, coverage_end, status, load_points, coverage_purpose, notes, source_type, service_mode, governed, projection_status, version_id, publication_id, projection_id)
             LEFT JOIN employees employee ON employee.id = assignment.assigned_employee_id
          WHERE assignment.service_date = sch_service_date(now()) AND timezone('America/Chicago'::text, now())::time without time zone >= assignment.coverage_start::time without time zone AND timezone('America/Chicago'::text, now())::time without time zone < assignment.coverage_end::time without time zone
          ORDER BY assignment.location_group_id, (
                CASE
                    WHEN assignment.coverage_purpose = ANY (ARRAY['restroom_check'::text, 'restroom_upkeep'::text, 'area_owner'::text]) THEN 0
                    ELSE 1
                END), assignment.coverage_start DESC
        )
 SELECT sch_service_date(now()) AS service_date,
    restroom.location_group_id,
    restroom.group_code,
    restroom.group_name AS schedule_package_name,
    restroom.location_id,
    restroom.location_code,
    restroom.location_name AS scanned_restroom_name,
    latest.last_completed_at,
    timezone('America/Chicago'::text, latest.last_completed_at) AS last_completed_at_central,
    latest.last_completed_by,
    latest.last_completed_device,
        CASE
            WHEN dashboard.latest_completed_at IS NOT NULL AND latest.last_completed_at IS NOT NULL THEN latest.last_completed_at + '01:30:00'::interval
            ELSE NULL::timestamp with time zone
        END AS next_check_due_at,
        CASE
            WHEN dashboard.latest_completed_at IS NOT NULL AND latest.last_completed_at IS NOT NULL THEN timezone('America/Chicago'::text, latest.last_completed_at + '01:30:00'::interval)
            ELSE NULL::timestamp without time zone
        END AS next_check_due_at_central,
        CASE
            WHEN dashboard.latest_completed_at IS NULL OR latest.last_completed_at IS NULL THEN 'not_cleaned_yet'::text
            WHEN (latest.last_completed_at + '01:30:00'::interval) <= now() THEN 'overdue'::text
            WHEN (latest.last_completed_at + '01:30:00'::interval) <= (now() + '00:15:00'::interval) THEN 'due_soon'::text
            ELSE 'ok'::text
        END AS timer_status,
        CASE
            WHEN dashboard.latest_completed_at IS NOT NULL AND latest.last_completed_at IS NOT NULL THEN round(EXTRACT(epoch FROM latest.last_completed_at + '01:30:00'::interval - now()) / 60.0)::integer
            ELSE NULL::integer
        END AS minutes_until_due,
    owner.assigned_employee_id,
    owner.assigned_owner,
    to_char(owner.coverage_start::interval, 'HH24:MI'::text) AS owner_coverage_start,
    to_char(owner.coverage_end::interval, 'HH24:MI'::text) AS owner_coverage_end,
    owner.coverage_purpose,
    owner.status AS owner_status,
        CASE
            WHEN dashboard.latest_completed_at IS NOT NULL AND latest.last_completed_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'scan_completion'::text
            ELSE 'no_scan_today'::text
        END AS timer_source
   FROM restroom_locations restroom
     LEFT JOIN v_location_dashboard_status dashboard ON dashboard.location_id = restroom.location_id
     LEFT JOIN latest_completion latest ON latest.location_id = restroom.location_id
     LEFT JOIN current_owner owner ON owner.location_group_id = restroom.location_group_id;

SELECT service_date,
    location_group_id,
    group_code,
    schedule_package_name,
    count(*)::integer AS restroom_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE timer_status <> 'not_cleaned_yet'::text)::integer AS cleaned_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE timer_status = 'not_cleaned_yet'::text)::integer AS not_cleaned_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE timer_status = 'due_soon'::text)::integer AS due_soon_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE timer_status = 'overdue'::text)::integer AS overdue_count,
    min(next_check_due_at) FILTER (WHERE next_check_due_at IS NOT NULL) AS next_package_due_at,
    min(next_check_due_at_central) FILTER (WHERE next_check_due_at_central IS NOT NULL) AS next_package_due_at_central,
    assigned_employee_id,
    assigned_owner,
    owner_coverage_start,
    owner_coverage_end,
        CASE
            WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE timer_status = 'overdue'::text) > 0 THEN 'overdue'::text
            WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE timer_status = 'due_soon'::text) > 0 THEN 'due_soon'::text
            WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE timer_status = 'not_cleaned_yet'::text) = count(*) THEN 'not_cleaned_yet'::text
            WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE timer_status = 'not_cleaned_yet'::text) > 0 THEN 'partially_cleaned'::text
            ELSE 'ok'::text
        END AS package_status
   FROM v_restroom_check_timers
  GROUP BY service_date, location_group_id, group_code, schedule_package_name, assigned_employee_id, assigned_owner, owner_coverage_start, owner_coverage_end;

WITH solution AS (

           FROM schedule_solution_assignments sa
             JOIN schedule_work_items wi ON wi.id = sa.work_item_id
             JOIN location_groups lg ON lg.id = sa.location_group_id
             LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.id = sa.assigned_employee_id
        ), lunch_windows AS (
         SELECT s.id,
            s.run_id,
            s.work_item_id,
            s.service_date,
            s.location_group_id,
            s.segment_number,
            s.assigned_employee_id,
            s.owner_type,
            s.coverage_start,
            s.coverage_end,
            s.coverage_purpose,
            s.status,
            s.source_type,
            s.source_daily_assignment_id,
            s.load_points,
            s.assignment_reason,
            s.score_total,
            s.score_breakdown,
            s.notes,
            s.created_at,
            s.required,
            s.may_be_open,
            s.scan_required,
            s.is_public_restroom,
            s.hard_rule_tags,
            s.group_code,
            s.group_name,
            s.employee_name,
            s.employee_code,
            lw.lunch_start,

 SELECT s.run_id,

    s.assigned_employee_id,
    'open_required'::text AS violation_type,

    (((('Required work item is OPEN or missing owner: '::text || s.group_name) || ' '::text) || s.coverage_start) || '-'::text) || s.coverage_end AS detail
   FROM solution s
  WHERE s.required = true AND (s.status <> 'ASSIGNED'::text OR s.assigned_employee_id IS NULL)
UNION ALL
 SELECT s.run_id,

    s.id AS assignment_id,
    s.location_group_id,
    s.assigned_employee_id,
    'restricted_assignment'::text AS violation_type,

    (('Restricted assignment: '::text || COALESCE(s.employee_name, 'OPEN'::text)) || ' -> '::text) || s.group_name AS detail
   FROM solution s

UNION ALL
 SELECT s.run_id,
    s.service_date,

    s.id AS assignment_id,
    s.location_group_id,

    'herpetarium_wednesday'::text AS violation_type,

UNION ALL
 SELECT s.run_id,
    s.service_date,
    s.work_item_id,
    s.id AS assignment_id,
    s.location_group_id,
    s.assigned_employee_id,
    'response_only_group_has_normal_work'::text AS violation_type,
